new_related_preprint.title: On the linearised force balance condition in the analysis of atomistic dislocation models
new_related_preprint.scope: Addresses missing zero-force-sum verification in far-field regularity for atomistic dislocation predictors; says pure screw case is already covered byBraun–Hudson–Ortner2022 and focuses nonzero edgecomponent.
new_related_preprint.implication: Potential contextual addition for Green/tail discussion. It does not prove a globalXYannihilationbarrier. Do not infer its forcebalance hypothesis solely from decay or import its conclusions to arbitrary predictors.
